method: Extract the original one-bit raster embedded in the PDF, map known PDF line coordinates to its native pixels, then enlarge each tight crop fivefold with nearest-neighbor interpolation. No smoothing, OCR, inferred pixels or new model training.
scope: Three representative narrative-prefix queries only; this does not claim a new full-page or corpus-wide review.
result: In each isolated native-pixel crop the initial vav stem and lower mass remain physically connected. No separate vowel class is established. Existing exact source notes are retained; no canonical text changes.
